name: Anezuma In'yoku Choukyou ~Buotoko de Hikkii na Boku to no Gikei ni wa Ienai Himitsu no Ecstasy
original_name: 姉妻淫欲調教 ～ブ男でヒッキーな僕との義兄には言えない秘密のエクスタシー
source:
"Hello, we've come to deliver your package!"
Addressed to me? Where on earth is it from?
I check the sender's address, but it's the name of a company I don't recognize.
What's going on? A package arriving from a place I have no idea about...
Uh-oh?! What's this?! It's a porn magazine.
And the cover has a distinctly S&M-esque, abnormal feel to it.
Why would something like this be addressed to me?!
I didn't order it, so someone in my house must have used my name without my permission.
If that's the case, it's most likely him. Yukine's husband, Kuga Koichi.
Damn him... He must have used my name so it wouldn't be a problem if the rest of the family found out.
But the contents of this book... Did he have this kind of hobby?
--Wait a second. So Yukine, too?!
As I look at the cover of the book again,
I picture Yukine being done the same thing in my head.
"Damn him!"
Even if they're married, there's no way he's making Yukine do this!
I can picture Yukine going along with his hobby and being treated horribly.
Ugh, Yukine... Yukine doing this for him...
Damn, I wish it was me.
The more I imagine him taking Yukine, the more jealousy burns within me.
"Ugh, Yukine... Why would I do this to someone like that... If it were me..."
